dashboard_dirty_group_shape_check.name: dashboard_dirty_group_shape_check
dashboard_dirty_group_shape_check.value: ((summary_type = 'answers'::dashboard_summary_type) AND (question_id IS NOT NULL) AND (question_version_id IS NOT NULL) AND (ticket_type IS NULL) AND (ticket_status IS NULL)) OR ((summary_type = 'sessions'::dashboard_summary_type) AND (question_id IS NULL) AND (question_version_id IS NULL) AND (ticket_type IS NULL) AND (ticket_status IS NULL)) OR ((summary_type = 'ombudsman'::dashboard_summary_type) AND (question_id IS NULL) AND (question_version_id IS NULL) AND (ticket_type IS NOT NULL) AND (ticket_status IS NOT NULL))

employee_shift_date_or_weekday_check.name: employee_shift_date_or_weekday_check
employee_shift_date_or_weekday_check.value: ((work_date IS NOT NULL) AND (day_of_week IS NULL)) OR ((work_date IS NULL) AND (day_of_week IS NOT NULL))

questions_kind_scope_check.name: questions_kind_scope_check
questions_kind_scope_check.value: ((question_kind = 'sector'::question_kind) AND (sector_id IS NOT NULL) AND (scope = 'sector_only'::question_scope) AND (is_nps = false)) OR ((question_kind = 'standard'::question_kind) AND (sector_id IS NULL) AND (scope = ANY (ARRAY['all_sectors'::question_scope, 'selected_sectors'::question_scope])))

shift_upload_result_version_check.name: shift_upload_result_version_check
shift_upload_result_version_check.value: ((result = 'accepted'::shift_upload_result) AND (resulting_version_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((result = 'rejected'::shift_upload_result) AND (resulting_version_id IS NULL))

submission_answer_status_score_check.name: submission_answer_status_score_check
submission_answer_status_score_check.value: ((status = 'answered'::answer_status) AND (score IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = 'skipped'::answer_status) AND (score IS NULL))
